vision.title: Vision
vision.content: To become a leading school in bilingual education, nurturing students with a global perspective, local roots, and the capacity for lifelong learning as future citizens connected to the world.

mission.title: Mission
mission.content: Through an environment that values both Chinese and English equally, combined with character education and diverse learning, we inspire every student's potential and cultivate independent, innovative learners.

bilingual.title: Bilingual Focus
bilingual.desc: Parallel Chinese-English instruction builds fluent bilingual communication and cross-cultural understanding.

culture.title: Cultural Enrichment
culture.desc: Blending the best of Eastern and Western culture, giving students a broad, multicultural perspective.

innovation.title: Innovative Thinking
innovation.desc: Encouraging exploration and hands-on practice to build problem-solving and creative adaptability.

character.title: Character Education
character.desc: Emphasizing moral development and interpersonal skills to raise warm, responsible future citizens.

events.title: Official Establishment
events.desc: The Keelung City Government issued the Directive on the Establishment and Operation of the English Education Resource Center, formally founding the Center to oversee English and bilingual education policy for the city's elementary and junior high schools.

events.title: Team Formation
events.desc: Selection of the convener, deputy convener, and specialist staff, along with recruitment of a foreign English teaching advisor, established the Center's task-force operating model.

events.title: Expanding Partnerships
events.desc: Worked with Keelung's elementary and junior high schools to advance co-teaching programs such as TFETP and ELTA, steadily growing the number of partner schools.

events.title: Ongoing Growth
events.desc: Hosts summer camps with foreign teachers, English speaking showcases, and other events supporting English and bilingual teaching citywide.

vision.name: A Harbour City with a Global Heart
vision.desc: Building on Keelung’s maritime education heritage to nurture a generation with global perspective and bilingual communication skills.

vision.name: Quality Bilingual Education, Shared Success
vision.desc: Building a supportive bilingual teaching ecosystem where resources are shared, teachers grow together, and every student thrives.

items.name: Integrating and Translating Resources
items.desc: Integrating central and municipal resources, translating the 108 Curriculum Guidelines into literacy-oriented teaching and multi-modal assessment.

items.name: Professional Support and Companionship
items.desc: Deepening advisory group and teacher community practice through hands-on bilingual and English capacity-building workshops.

items.name: Foreign Teacher Management and Impact
items.desc: Strengthening FET/ELTA recruitment and management, promoting local-foreign co-teaching to raise bilingual teaching outcomes across schools.

items.name: Digital Sharing and Connection
items.desc: Building a digital English resource platform and community channels that connect teachers, parents, and the wider community.

orgStructure.title: Organizational Structure
orgStructure.desc: The Center operates under the supervision of the Keelung City Government Education Department, using a task-force model to coordinate English and bilingual education policy for all city schools.

staff.title: Program Staff
staff.desc: Handle day-to-day operations, event planning, and cross-school coordination

consultants.title: Local & Foreign English Teaching Advisers and Counsellors
consultants.desc: Co-teach English in schools, support the TFETP and ELTA programs, and provide instructional coaching.
